# CreateMem

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Creates a memory object that can be mapped, shared, injected and used for DMA.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x04` SVC_CREATE | `OBJECT_MEMORY (4)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Handle CreateMem(size_t page_count, CreateMemoryFlags flags);
```

**Registers:** `(pages, flags) -> r0 memory handle or error`

Without flags, pages are allocated on first touch. MEM_CONTIG allocates physically contiguous, zeroed pages up front (required for DMA); MEM_UNCACHED makes mappings uncached and needs MEM_CONTIG.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `page_count` | in | Size in pages; must be at least 1. |
| `flags` | in | MEM_CONTIG and/or MEM_UNCACHED, or 0. |

## Returns

A memory handle with all permissions, or a negative error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | `page_count` is 0, `flags` has unknown bits, or MEM_UNCACHED without MEM_CONTIG. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../errors.md#err_nomem) | Not enough free (or contiguous) memory, or the handle table is full. |
